prefix_rule: For each original final-O head A, form U spanning col(A) intersect ker((A V32_head.T).T). Delete its whole allowed output subspace: A_release=(I-U U.T)A, then quantize once toFP32. Select one head by largest ||M_original.T U U.T C_public||F, stable first tie. No adjustable rank, strength, image or attack-score selection. If selected head violates original D0.5 budget, stop; do not substitute another head.
compensation: B change=||B|| U9 K R32; U9 is original centered class-numerator space; R32 are source activation right singular directions outside original task-B right32. Minimize norm(K) subject to finite LN endpoint cones and remaining original joint budget. This is not a claim to maximize joint distance globally.
mathematical_scope: Rank deletion is noninvertible. With full-rank original head and tiny finite ridge, originalAGA column output differs by approximately -U U.T C. Verify this using actual quantized tensors and unchanged author solver before any images; operator/class-numerator change alone does not prove final normalized classification harm. Reuse the complete finite-LN norm-envelope inner cone only as a source functional feasibility test.

stopping_rule: First parameter-only gate and independent NumPy reconstruction. If passed, freeze this sole prefix and source protocol before source images, then one original finite-LN cone/minimum-norm B solve. Any numerical/source/probe/fresh-confirm/full-task failure closes point. No alternate head/rank/strength/source/backend or parameter-budget relaxation. If all task gates pass, unchangedTA0.5 and originalAGA target-only/both. Separate legitimate source proxies from unknown partner effects.
novelty: Rank pruning, SVD, least-squares compensation and SOCP are known. This is a mechanistic candidate feasibility test, not a new or effective Defense2 claim. Its distinction from closed outward rank-one repulsion is actual column-information removal, checked after finite-ridge originalAGA.
